blocks.orig: Explore the vibrant city of Arusha with a half-day city tour. In a lovely mix of fun and culture, this tour takes you to the city’s most beautiful and interesting spots. Accompanied by a guide, you’ll visit a local market, a school, and a church before wrapping up the day with a brewery experience at Twiga Brewery. Here, you get a behind-the-scenes look at the brewing process and enjoy a tasting flight of four freshly tapped Twiga Beers (18+ only). Children are welcome too, with complimentary soft drinks and a supervised playground nearby.
blocks.html: On a half-day city tour you discover lively Arusha. Mixing fun with culture, the tour brings you to the most beautiful and interesting places in the city. Together with a guide, you’ll stop at a local market, a school and a church, and you end the day at Twiga Brewery. There you see what goes on behind the scenes of the brewing process and taste a flight of four freshly tapped Twiga Beers (18+ only). Children are also welcome: they get free soft drinks, and there is a supervised playground close by.
